row_granularity: one claimant row within a claim block; each claim block can contain multiple claimant rows
notes: The detail is organized as policy blocks, followed by multi-line claim headers and claimant tables. Claim-level fields appear above the claimant rows and must be carried to each row; claimant table headers repeat for each claim. The two Paid and two Reserve columns are distinguished by the Indemnity/Loss and Expense group headers. Recoveries contains Deductible and All Other. Claim Totals, Policy Totals, and Account Totals are subtotal rows, not claim rows. The summaries report 5 claim blocks, while the detail contains 7 claimant data rows. No closed date is shown even where Status is Closed.
